messages:
jamie: Heads up — please hold on merging PR #12788 until we complete the DB schema migration tonight (22:30 UTC). Don’t land anything that touches users.profile until I confirm. @alex can you block the merge queue?

alex: Yep, will add a `do-not-merge` label now and stop auto-merges. CI maintenance window is 22:15-22:45 UTC, fyi — any jobs starting right before that can flake.

maria: Rebased and addressed review comments earlier today, won’t try to force-land. @jamie ping me when the migration is done and I’ll re-run a quick CI if needed.

sre-oncall: Noted. I’ll have monitoring on standby and can flip traffic routing if the migration causes brief downtime :eyes:.

devops-bot: Ops scheduled migration window: 2026-03-17 22:30 UTC. Reminder: to minimize false negatives, run `./scripts/run-ci.sh --preserve-cache` before attempting a final land.

alex: Added label and set temporary merge-freeze at 22:10 UTC. If CI completes before then we still keep the freeze to be safe.

jamie: Thanks. If a critical hotfix must land, tag me and I’ll approve a manual bypass, but prefer to avoid rebases during the window.

maria: Quick note — integration:test-suite-7 is failing on the last run, looks unrelated to schema change. @alex can you trigger a rerun so we have a green baseline before we attempt landing?

alex: Kicking a rerun now: `ci rerun pr-12788` — will post status.

devops-bot: CI rerun started: https://ci.example.com/builds/4567 — watch logs for flaky DB timeouts.

sre-oncall: If rerun passes and there’s no schema overlap, we might be able to land before the migration cutoff. Let’s hold decision until 22:05 UTC and then confirm.

jamie: Agreed. I’ll post an update at 22:05 with final status.

(22:05 update) jamie: Migration proceeded on schedule. Ops reports some brief lock contention but completed at 22:34 UTC. Safe window to merge now — proceed if CI is green.

alex: Removing `do-not-merge` label and merging now :rocket:.

maria: Thanks all — will watch post-deploy metrics.

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards look clean so far. Happy path.

Note: thread contains links to CI logs and short commands used to coordinate reruns and holds.
